top_concerns: Reported numbers are internally inconsistent: prose vs Table 1/Table 3 mismatches, and Table 3 failure counts (e.g., 920 for Opus 4.1) exceed the 731-task public set
Contamination resistance is asserted from GPL licensing with no empirical contamination test; the held-out set is not evaluated
Requirements and interface fields derived from the tests narrow the task; no ablation without them, and the 'hours to days' long-horizon claim is unmeasured
Thin protocol: single scaffold, single run, no CIs, no cost budgets; context-overflow failures may come from the scaffold
Human augmentation and verification are under-documented (no annotator agreement, filtering funnel or leakage audit), and the findings are largely descriptive
